issues.description: The exercise asks to "add getters for all the private fields" and presents Stock as an encapsulated inventory managed via methods (add/take/find/addToStockIngredients/emptyStock). However, both template and solution expose a public Stock#setStockIngredients(...) method that allows external code to replace the entire internal StockIngredient[] array, undermining the intended encapsulation and potentially confusing students about whether direct replacement is part of the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove Stock#setStockIngredients from the student-facing API (or make it package-private and document it as test-only). If tests need to inspect contents, keep only getStockIngredients() plus the Stock manipulation methods specified in the UML.

issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to be static (shared stock usage), but the reference solution implements calculateTotalPrice(Meal) as a non-static instance method. This contradicts the specification and can break student implementations/tests that expect to call SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) without an instance.
issues.suggestedFix: Make SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) static in the solution (and align the template/student expectation accordingly), or update the problem statement to not require it to be static.
